title: ODS Pilot portable connection
description: Portable connection file format used to export/import ODS server configurations without secrets.

name.description: Display name for the server entry in ODS Pilot.

url.description: Base URL of the ODS API, or a local ATFX file path for atfx connections.

auth_type.description: Authentication mode. Choose basic for username/password, m2m for client credentials, oidc for browser-based OpenID Connect, or atfx for local ATFX files.

username.description: Username for basic authentication. Required when auth_type is basic.

token_endpoint.description: OAuth token endpoint used for m2m authentication. Required when auth_type is m2m.

client_id.description: Client identifier for m2m or oidc authentication. Required when auth_type is m2m or oidc.

scope.description: Optional scopes for m2m authentication. Leave empty for most setups.

webfinger_path_prefix.description: Optional path prefix used by some OIDC providers for WebFinger discovery.

redirect_uri.description: Redirect URI used for OIDC browser authentication. If http: is used, the redirect_url_allow_insecure flag must be set to true.

redirect_url_allow_insecure.description: Allow insecure redirect URLs during OIDC login. Only enable if your provider requires it.

verify_certificate.description: Whether TLS certificate validation is enabled for HTTPS endpoints. Disable only for test or self-signed environments.

context_variables.description: Optional context variables passed to the ODS connection for environment or workflow-specific setup.
